verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can register a URL and AgentMail sends a POST request with event details as soon as an event happens, instead of polling. WebSockets offer a real-time alternative, and the multi-tenancy docs mention routing webhook events per pod. missing for 10: an enumerated list of event types, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration that webhooks work.
